race.comment: MISHANI WITNESS (2) got the job done at Ipswich two back before not being disgraced at Saturday metro level last time out. Gets some weight off with the 2kg claim and can do much better in this more suitable affair. The penny has dropped for BRAIN WAVE (7) who has put back-to-back wins together and is racing high on confidence of late. Draws the inside alley and is a big chance to bring up the hat-trick. POWER REECE (11) put in an improved performance at the latest effort and Cartwright sticks in the irons. Top-three commodity. NAUGHTY NURSE (9) is one from one around this circuit and must be respected out of the Lees barn. A must for the multiples. SOLIDUDE (4) best of the rest with the claim.
